gdpval.label: GDPval-AA v2 (normalized)
gdpval.description: Real-world professional deliverables across 44 occupations and 9 industries.

scicode.label: SciCode
scicode.description: Scientific coding problems requiring knowledge, reasoning and code synthesis.

hle.label: Humanity's Last Exam
hle.description: Frontier expert-level academic reasoning across disciplines.

gpqa.label: GPQA Diamond
gpqa.description: Graduate-level scientific reasoning designed to resist simple web lookup.

lcr.label: AA-LCR
lcr.description: Long-context extraction, reasoning and synthesis across 10k-100k token documents.

omniscienceAccuracy.label: AA-Omniscience Accuracy
omniscienceAccuracy.description: Factual answer accuracy across economically relevant domains.

omniscienceReliability.label: AA-Omniscience Reliability
omniscienceReliability.description: Derived as 1 - AA-Omniscience hallucination rate; higher is more reliable.

roles.label: Architect
roles.purpose: Architecture, decomposition, design trade-offs and high-level technical judgment.
roles.note: Prioritizes professional deliverables, long-context synthesis and hard reasoning.

roles.label: Strategist
roles.purpose: Arbitration, product/architecture trade-offs and decision quality under ambiguity.
roles.note: Balances professional judgment with factuality and long-context reasoning.

roles.label: Security Reviewer
roles.purpose: Adversarial review of implementation risks, unsafe assumptions and failure modes.
roles.note: Proxy methodology: no dedicated security benchmark currently satisfies 100% coverage; uses coding, difficult reasoning and reliability components only.

roles.label: Code Reviewer
roles.purpose: Independent review of code, edge cases, regressions and implementation quality.
roles.note: SciCode is the dominant coding signal; reasoning and context support review quality.

roles.label: Implementer
roles.purpose: Normal coding implementation and iterative patch/test work.
roles.note: Terminal-Bench is intentionally excluded because it does not have 100% coverage of the scored Max universe.

roles.label: Implementer Heavy
roles.purpose: Greenfield builds, large refactors and complex implementation work.
roles.note: Adds professional-deliverable and long-context weight to coding for larger project work.

roles.label: Synthesizer
roles.purpose: Aggregate many inputs into a coherent, faithful final output.
roles.note: Long-context synthesis and factual reliability dominate.

roles.label: Researcher
roles.purpose: Broad research, evidence synthesis and difficult question answering.
roles.note: Focuses on synthesis, professional research output, factual accuracy and hard reasoning.
